      41                         : // are recording propagation info.

      44                         : // 1. an IRFunc ONLY if it is not generic (func is in the global scope). 'inst' must
      45                         : //    be inside the func.
      46                         : // 2. an IRSpecialize(generic, ...). 'inst' must be inside the generic. the
      47                         : //    specialization args must all be global values (either concrete types/values, or collections).
      48                         : // 3. an IRSpecializeExistentialsInFunc wrapping an IRFunc. 'inst' must be inside the underlying
      49                         : //    func.
      50                         : // 4. an IRModuleInst. 'inst' must be a direct child of the module (a module-scope global inst).
